correctness.rationale: TARGET route per report; audited normally. Numerics artifact verifies only |bP16|=8128 arithmetic. Smooth-layer essentials are asserted by analogy: 65024 pseudo-isotopy threshold, mu(Sigma_M)=1 and mu(Sigma_K)=0, Gauss transformation divisibility in 16D, and R(M)=lcm(8,2^r d_o) with r in 0..6 from CN Sec.4 2-adic analysis are cited as verbatim transfer with 28->8128, without dimension-specific proofs. Reactivity is used to complete uniqueness before it is established. Essential inferences unverified.

originality.rationale: Headline is literal 15D instantiation of Crowley-Nordstrom Theorem 1.3 already recorded in CN Remark 1.15: two string-bordism classes, each satisfying version of Thm 1.3 with mod-8128 Gauss refinements. Thesis Theorem B already gives dim-15 almost classification; Theta15=Z/8128+Z/2 and OmegaString15 facts are standard. Substitution 28->8128, spin->string is mechanically implied with no new idea; prior statement substantively covers claim.

value.rationale: Even if correct, result is a mere parameter substitution explicitly foreshadowed in CN Remark 1.15 (replace mod-28 by mod-8128, split into two string classes). STANDARD rejects mere parameter substitutions and recomputation/certification that adds no new object, boundary, or interpretation. Arithmetic certification of 8128 does not create independent retrieval value.
